summary: Denison Mines Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing interim financial statements, MD&A, certifications, voting results, and a press release for Q1 2026. This is a routine quarterly report with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is standard for a foreign private issuer and does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
